base.evidence: Fixed representative area sensitivity: q(1024)*phi(1024) from synthetic dendrites aggregates. Holding this ratio at all sizes and combining it with Brown–Francis is a modelling scenario, not a habit-specific mass fit. Earth cloud aggregate relation; not validated for 0.15–0.60 m snow. No riming, crystal habit fractions or geometric scatter represented.
